blurb: Spicy Sports offers premium ski and snowboard rentals for men, women, and kids, with equipment tuned after each use. They also rent recreational bikes, e-bikes, kids' bikes, and chariots for exploring Whistler's trails. Two convenient locations serve guests in Whistler's Main Village and Upper Village.
